newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Fotolabo sees 1997 operating profit rising.
newsitem.headline: Fotolabo sees 1997 operating profit rising.

text.p: Swiss photofinishing, publishing and mail-order sales company Fotolabo SA expects sales and ordinary operating profit to grow in 1997, it said in a statement.

"Based on the first four months of 1997, Fotolabo expects a growth of its consolidated turnover of approximately five percent this year. The improvement of the ordinary operating profit should substantially exceed 10 percent," it said.
Group sales rose 54 percent in 1996 to 306.8 million Swiss francs while ordinary operating profit rose 33 percent to 39.9 million. -- Zurich newsroom +41 1 631 7340
